source.paper: Fetna (2026), Opening-Range Breakout Does Not Survive Trading Costs, unreviewed preprint
sourced_rules: one-minute N-bar opening range with void range on any missing minute
first post-range minute close outside range, next minute open entry
one trade per side, no re-entry after stop, no same-bar double breakout
R2 stop 10% of prior 14-day ATR, no target, flat at close
gap-through stop fill at bar open
source.paper_result: headline negative after costs; adaptation is a falsification/replication, not a demonstrated edge
source.selection_history: Fetna 225-cell grid and Mesfin MNQ ORB previously reviewed; local ORB trial inventory and inherited selection adjustment require review

instrument.primary_roll: D-ROLL-01 fixed expiration minus eight calendar days, holiday-adjusted per versioned mapping
instrument.event_exclusion: none for eligible primary sessions; unknown event/calendar coverage fail closed

rule.signal: first completed one-minute bar closing strictly above range high (long) or strictly below range low (short) after range completion
rule.entry: next one-minute open only; missing target minute means skip and log; never fill a missing minute
rule.opposite_direction_after_stopped_trade: allowed if flat and direction unused
rule.simultaneous_double_break: mathematically impossible for one close with range high >= low; assert invariant

atr.contract_history: dated contract being traded; no stitching
atr.missing_prior_bar_policy: candidate session ineligible from data if any required prior close unavailable; not outcome-dependent
atr.insufficient_history_policy: candidate session ineligible if fewer than 14 complete prior sessions for this dated contract
atr.rounding_tie_policy: exact half tick rounds upward in stop distance (ROUND_HALF_UP), minimum one tick

rule.stop: stop price, or bar open if gap-through is worse; on entry bar assume stopped when touched; no target
rule.position_overlap: never; opposite-side sequential trade only after position closes
rule.availability: one-minute OHLC known only at bar end; entry at subsequent minute open
rule.missing_stop_minute_and_unavailable_flat: unknown execution; stress bound on missing minute with live stop = worse of stop level and next visible adverse extreme, never observed fill; report gap incidence; unavailable next bar or flatten -> non-evaluable
rule.missing_stop_gap_threshold_proposal: if >1% eligible sessions OR >1% executed trades affected, affected result inconclusive; below threshold any decision sensitive to bound also inconclusive; Jason approval pending

costs.accounting: Subtract L3 exactly once per completed round trip from reference-price P&L; no extra spread or stop slippage added; gap-through OHLC reference remains adverse
costs.stress: L1-L4 fixed, L5 delayed/no-fill scenario; nonselectable

data_partitions.date_basis: America/Chicago CME session/trade-date mapping (to be fixed in calendar manifest)

controls.sampling: uniform legal post-range entry minute through 14:30 CT, random direction; same dated contract, ATR stop, flatten, cost and missing-minute policy

inference.estimand: MNQ net USD per eligible day at L3, including zero for no-trade days
inference.primary_statistic: daily ORB net USD minus paired random-anchor control net USD, one-sided mean
inference.resampling: stationary block bootstrap of paired eligible days, nominal mean block length 5 days
inference.decision: paired one-sided test plus observed absolute MNQ net mean >= 15 USD/eligible day; lower one-sided confidence bound >15 is a separate unselected alternative for freeze review, NOT an additional gate; selection treatment and feasibility still need approval

development_only_prop_eval.input: frozen rule's development-only L3 daily net MNQ series plus all 500 same-session control paths, including zeros; chronological eligibility manifest
development_only_prop_eval.method: stationary block bootstrap complete paired calendar days, mean block length five eligible days; common resampled day indices across ORB and all control draws; preserve serial dependence and path shape

ambiguity.response: review before held-out; no tuning on held-out

freeze_blockers: approve missing-stop-gap >1% frequency alarm and below-threshold verdict sensitivity
official early closes/halts and dev-only chosen-contract eligibility/coverage audit
random control matching, aggregation, legal minutes and seed
one-sided test/bootstrap and joint power target based on real dev-only series
freeze-time source data, code, lock, calendar and seed hashes
prop-eval venue's exact target, drawdown, daily limit, horizon and intraday path before any eval probability is reported
